summary_1line: Agastya recounts Narada’s tale of how the monkey Riksharajas transformed into a woman and bore Bali and Sugriva through Indra and the Sun.

image_candidates.scene_text: On golden Mount Meru, tears falling from Brahma’s eyes strike the earth and a monkey suddenly arises from them.
The monkey Riksharajas leaps into a lake on Mount Meru and emerges transformed into a radiant, beautiful woman on the shore.
Indra and the Sun-god gaze in desire at the luminous woman beside the mountain lake as the births of Bali and Sugriva are conceived.
